summary: The first run of P26. It reported all 18 rendered prompts as carrying the pinned template block, because it compared only the block's first 200 bytes - and the nine prompts rendered from the uncommitted revision 1 share that opening. It also did not yet check that a normalised shape stands for one input. Both claims were wrong in the same way, and the parent directory's run corrects them.
